tagline: Grams that count, from sources you can name.
description: The largest category in sport nutrition and the one with the most creative labelling. We read the amino profile before the marketing, reject anything spiked to inflate a protein reading, and rank on protein per calorie, leucine per serving and what the rest of the tub is made of.

copy.unit_basis: Based on declared nutrition, per 25 g protein.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your protein?
copy.empty_title: Nothing here clears our bar yet.
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 546 protein products reaching Kuwait and published none. A shelf is whatever clears our listing floor, and nothing in this category does yet — we would rather show you an empty shelf than a padded one.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Products a founder put on the shelf from the database, whatever their score.

types.name: Whey Protein Isolate
types.purpose: The highest protein-per-calorie option, with the lactose largely filtered out.
non_negotiables: At least 80% protein by weight, so you are paying for protein and not filler
No proprietary blend — the amino profile is disclosed or the product is out
No artificial sweeteners, colours or amino-spiking agents
At least 2.5 g leucine per serving, the threshold for muscle protein synthesis

types.name: Whey Protein Concentrate
types.purpose: Less processed than isolate, more of the native whey fractions, lower price per gram.
non_negotiables: Single-source whey, not a blend hiding a cheaper protein
No proprietary blend and no non-protein nitrogen sources
Added sugar under 3 g per serving
Traceable dairy origin

types.name: Casein & Slow-Release Protein
types.purpose: Slow-digesting protein for the long gap between meals, usually taken at night.
non_negotiables: Micellar casein, not acid or sodium caseinate
No artificial sweeteners or colours
Full amino disclosure

types.name: Plant Protein
types.purpose: Dairy-free protein that still delivers a complete amino profile.
non_negotiables: Complete amino profile, or a blend engineered to be complete
Published heavy-metal testing — plant proteins concentrate what the soil held
No artificial sweeteners; no gum-heavy texture engineering
At least 2.3 g leucine per serving

types.name: Collagen Peptides
types.purpose: Connective-tissue support. Not a muscle protein — we grade it as what it is.
non_negotiables: Hydrolysed, with the peptide molecular weight disclosed
Traceable, grass-fed or marine-certified source
Single ingredient wherever possible

types.name: Protein Bars
types.purpose: Protein you can keep in a bag. The category where the worst labels hide.
non_negotiables: Sugar alcohols under 5 g per bar
No artificial sweeteners, no artificial colours, no hydrogenated fat
Protein at or above 12% of bar weight
Recognisable whole-food base, not a syrup matrix

types.name: Ready-to-Drink Protein
types.purpose: Shelf-stable liquid protein for when a shaker is not an option.
non_negotiables: No carrageenan or polysorbate 80
No artificial sweeteners
At least 20 g protein per bottle
